post.caption: A toilet wore 40,815 diamonds. A Hong Kong jeweler called Coronet set them on a gold toilet. Together, the diamonds weigh 334.68 carats. It first appeared at a trade expo in Shanghai in November 2019. The gold toilet has a bulletproof seat, set with the diamonds. Aaron Shum said the idea came from an Andy Lau song. In January 2020, it went to a museum in Dubai. Guinness gave Coronet a record for most diamonds on a toilet. It was the jeweler's tenth Guinness record. Earlier, the jeweler set records with a diamond watch and a handbag.
